acoustic.hammer_hardness: Global felt hardness plus 3 velocity anchor bands: Piano (~MIDI vel 41), Mezzo forte (~MIDI vel 70), Forte (~MIDI vel 98).
acoustic.spectrum_profile: 8 sliders (profil_1..8) scaling the amplitude of the first 8 overtones (1 = fundamental) per note; PRO Note Edit extends per-note editing to thousands of overtones.
acoustic.hammer_noise: Weight of percussive hammer felt impact sound (independent from hammer brightness).
acoustic.hammer_tone: Balances low-frequency woody hammer impact vs high-pitched string contact attack.
acoustic.soft_level: Smoothing degree of una corda / soft pedal (models striking with a softer part of the hammer felt).

electro_acoustic.pickup_symmetry: Moves pickup from asymmetric rest position to symmetric position; exact symmetry causes octave-up frequency doubling.
electro_acoustic.pickup_distance: Controls distance between tone source (tine/reed/bar) and pickup; closer distance increases distortion and soft-vs-loud timbral contrast.

clavinet.pickups: Four discrete standard settings A-C (lower), B-C (upper), A-D (both in phase), B-D (both out of phase) plus continuous blending via clavinet_low_mic / clavinet_high_mic.
clavinet.registers: Original tone colour register switches: Brilliant (Bright), Treble, Medium, Soft.

syngular.note: Replaces Hammer Noise, Hammer Tone, and Soft Pedal on main panel with Vibrato/Tremolo Rate and Depth controls wired to Note Effects.

acoustic_soundboard.impedance: Mechanical impedance (force/velocity ratio) of soundboard; higher impedance yields slower energy transfer and longer sustain.
acoustic_soundboard.impedance_cutoff: Frequency threshold above which soundboard impedance begins to drop.
acoustic_soundboard.impedance_slope_q_factor: Rate (q_factor) at which impedance decreases above cutoff, governing high-overtone decay speed.

design.string_length: Controls bass-to-treble string scaling and stiff-string inharmonicity (up to 10 m virtual grand length for near-zero inharmonicity; e.g. 2.7 m grand ranges ~2 m bass to ~5 cm treble).
design.strike_point: Controls hammer/mallet strike position along string/bar; supports Humanize random per-hit variation (especially for chromatic percussion).
design.sympathetic_resonance: Damper-state-dependent string coupling energy (supports silent-key hold and sustain-pedal excitation).
design.duplex_scale: Undamped front-scale (tuning pins to frame) and rear-scale (bridge to frame) string resonances (1872 Steinway/Helmholtz patent).

blooming.origin: Nonlinear mechanical energy transfer in thin steel sheets (Steel Drum / steelpans) transferring attack energy from lower to higher overtones.

electro_acoustic.tine_noises: Separate hammer-on-tine attack noise and damper-on-tine release noise (Vintage Tines MKI/MKII; LV2 exposes hammer_tine_noise).

syngular.envelope_mapping: Replaces soundboard mechanical parameters with Attack, Decay, Decay Cutoff, Decay Slope, Release (= Action Damping Duration + Damper Position shaping), plus Harmonicity (inverse bell-like inharmonicity).

behavior.initial_delay: Delay before the first bounce (free ms/normalized via bounce_delay or tempo-synced via bounce_sync + bounce_sync_speed with 30 rhythmic subdivisions from 16d down to 1/32t).
behavior.velocity_sensitivity: Increases initial bounce interval at high note velocity (simulating higher mallet drop height).
behavior.delay_loss: Geometric/progressive reduction in inter-bounce interval from each bounce to the next.
behavior.humanization: Stochastic per-bounce jitter across delay and velocity parameters.
behavior.attack_envelope: Shapes attack transient specifically for bounced repetitions (or initial notes in Note Effects).
behavior.mallet_damping_sec_9_2: Sustained notes damping option under sustain pedal: dampen via Low-velocity note-on or Aftertouch.

features.per_note_lfo: Shared LFO per note with Shape, Skew, Rate, Phase, Phase-Locked switch, and Onset Duration fade-in.
features.vibrato: Frequency modulation depth in cents (nfx_vibrato) with positive/negative pitch asymmetry bias (nfx_vibrato_offset).
features.tremolo: Amplitude modulation depth in dB (nfx_tremolo_depth) with relative phase offset to vibrato (nfx_tremolo_phase).
features.attack_envelope_and_smear: Per-note transient shaping (attack_envelope) and waveform/partial attack smoothing (smear).
features.monophonic_mode_ui_state: Manual Sec. 13.4 describes Mono mode with Legato (suppresses attack on slurred notes) and Portamento (pitch glide rate); these toggles are UI/FXP state and not dedicated top-level LV2 parameters.

main_equalizer.processing_stage: Pre-processing (modifies partial amplitudes inside the physical model before audio synthesis).
main_equalizer.key_property: Automatic volume compensation preserves natural keyboard register balance; supports arbitrary user-added control points.
main_equalizer.resonance_controls: Includes Res Eq (equalizes sympathetic resonances) and Res Dur (scales sympathetic resonance duration).

effect_slots.chain_architecture: 3 serial switchable FX slots followed by post_effect_gain.

lv2_default_slot_mapping.effect_1: Delay (Mix, Time, Feedback, Tone, Polarity, Ping-Pong)

reverb.architecture: Convolution reverb simulating acoustic rooms (Studio to Cathedral, Taj Mahal), Plate, Spring, Speakers, Broceliande, plus external WAV impulse loading in Standard & PRO.

controls.pre_delay: Gap between direct sound and reverberant onset.
controls.tone: Tilt EQ applied exclusively to reflected wet signal.
controls.early_reflections: Relative dB balance between early reflections and reverberation tail.
controls.lv2_additional: reverb_envelope and reverb_resampling exposed in dsp.ttl.

harp_diatonic_mode.keyboard_mapping: White keys produce notes; 7 pedals (D, C, B, E, F, G, A left-to-right) are controlled by groups of 3 black keys (left = flat, center = natural, right = sharp).

guitar_mode.string_model: 6-string virtual fretboard with automatic or Adv. manual left-hand position, string-forcing keyswitches, open-string keyswitch, automatic chord string-conflict resolver, and custom tunings.

techniques.legato: Hammer-on / pull-off within minor third when first note held (Leg. On / guitar_legato).
techniques.glissando: Triggered when starting note is interrupted by ending note; ending velocity sets slide speed; chord glissando computed relative to bass note.
techniques.pinch_harmonics: Continuous pedal or keyswitch stopping vibration at half resonating length (flageolet).
techniques.palm_mute: Right-hand palm damping via continuous Buff Stop pedal (lute_stop_pedal) or keyswitch.
techniques.rasgueado_and_strums: Flamenco rasgueado plus up/down chord strum and fast single-note repetition keyswitches.

guitar_mode.realism_and_routing: Casual-to-Pro slider (virtuosity) for fret/slide/body squeaks; hollow vs solid body (guitar_body); gate vs toggle keyswitch modes; per-string MIDI channel routing and separate keyswitch MIDI channel.

edition_differences.stage: Up to 48 kHz; no physical model tweaking or Note Edit.
edition_differences.standard: Up to 48 kHz; Note Edit restricted to Volume, Detune, and Attack Envelope.
edition_differences.pro: Up to 192 kHz internal sample rate; per-note editing across physical parameters (Tuning/Detune, Unison Width, Direct Sound Duration, Hammer Hardness, Strike Point, String Length, Spectrum Profile [thousands of overtones], Soundboard Impedance, Damper Position, Velocity Offset).

pro_note_edit.curve_editing_tools: Control Notes rail (double-click to add/remove anchors), Shift+drag fine tuning, shape operators: Random, Smooth, Rescale, Reset.

octave_stretching_note_edit.roughness_slider: Smooths transitions between adjacent Stretch Points across keyboard range; interacts directly with String Length inharmonicity.

spectrum_profile_note_edit.interpolation: Independent set of control notes; linear interpolation across intermediate keys.
